_aviso: DADOS DE DEMONSTRAÇÃO. `status` e `support` foram atribuídos por uma regra fixa (ciclo pelo índice do item), não por revisão nem por modelo. Itens, citações e relações vêm do gabarito sintético do eval.

relations.note: Report says no other module reads billing tables; post-mortem found the reporting module reading them directly.
The cost plan assumes five services; the on-call rotation supports at most three.
The capacity memo says the plan of five services is not supported by staffing.
The decision log commits to five services by the end of Q3; the capacity memo says the on-call rotation supports at most three.
The decision log commits to five services by the end of Q3; the capacity memo says current staffing does not support running five.
Median vs 95th percentile: different statistics, no conflict.
The same quantity in different units (2 MB = 2048 KB).
Different time horizons: no reduction in year one, a likely reduction by year three.
The fourth service is conditional on hiring; the current limit stays three.

Similar but not the same claim: the report says billing is the least coupled module; the cost memo says it has the fewest dependencies and adds that it carries the lowest extraction cost. A linker that calls them duplicates is wrong.
A specific case (checkout and account management) and the general statement it illustrates (modules that look independent). They support each other but are not the same claim.
A 50 ms budget per call between services versus a p95 of 484 ms for the whole checkout flow: different scopes, no conflict.
